artboards.title: Run page — Cockpit + inline injected-email highlight
Compare — its own page, same chrome

annotations.text:
CHOSEN — Option A (Cockpit) + Option C’s inline injected-email highlight.
Left rail 240px: launcher (Scenario · Agent naïve/fixed · Attack · Run) + recent runs. Centre: Event timeline; the injected block is shown highlighted inside #2 read_thread, and the Violation on #8 links back to it. Right 400px: Trust Score (headline + 5 Dimensions) over the world diff.
Replay: scrubber under the timeline. Compare: its own page (below).

STATES — one design, three moments:
· LIVE: score panel shows “evaluating…” until the Evaluator runs; timeline grows; Run → Stop.
· COMPLETED: as drawn.
· REPLAY: same page; the scrubber decides which events are visible; Dimension bars fill as each Check resolves.

API the page needs: GET /runs/{id} → { status, scenario, agent, attack, events[], violations[], score:{headline,capped,dimensions[]}, diff[] } — polled every 500 ms while status=running. Prompt diff: GET /agents/{version}/prompt for both versions; diff client-side.
OPTION B — Verdict first. Not chosen. Score-first top band, evidence below. Kept for reference — the ‘Why 40’ sentence is worth stealing into A’s score panel.
OPTION C — Transcript. Not chosen, but its inline injected-email highlight was adopted into the Run page.
